summary: Iter 44 — Partnership Agreement v2 re-sign hardening verified end-to-end. 14/14 backend pytest tests pass covering admin endpoints (versions list with signature_count + active_partner_count, default-v2-draft 7000+ chars admin-only, signatures hydration with user_email/ip_address, publish flow with rollback), per-partner blocked_actions list for Elena, gate firing on /me/research, /me/payouts/w9, /me/payouts/method (all 409 agreement_required), admin bypass on /studio/generate, /me/research, /me/payouts/w9 (no 409), and sign flow. 5/5 UI checks pass: /admin dashboard has Partnership agreements quick-action card; /admin/legal/agreements renders 3 tiles + version list with progress bars + Draft & publish button; Draft modal opens with 'Seed from Birthright v2.0 starter' button + version/summary/body fields; AgreementResignBanner shows for unsigned admin with 'What's blocked? (N)' toggle that reveals blocked list; /legal/agreement renders body + sign button.
critical_code_review_comments: legal.py POST /indemnification/versions uses asyncio.create_task without awaiting at process shutdown — if uvicorn reloads or container restarts mid-publish, partner notification emails for some recipients may be dropped silently. Consider a lightweight outbox table or background-task queue for delivery guarantees in production.

agreement_gate.require_active_agreement_partner exempts admins by role string match `role == 'admin'`. If a foundation_admin or similar role is added later, gate will silently lock them out. Suggest centralising 'is_foundation_operator(user)' helper.

my-status blocked_actions logic is duplicated knowledge with the gates themselves — a single source-of-truth registry mapping endpoint -> friendly label would keep banner/UI honest as new gated endpoints are added.

Publish endpoint version field is capped at 20 chars (pydantic) — UI 'Seed from Birthright v2.0 starter' is fine ('2.0' = 3 chars), but admin-facing copy nowhere surfaces this constraint. A simple maxLength hint on the input would prevent confusing 422s.
